title: UI/使用性テストと操作効率検証
basis: User-requested additional stage after C-03 and before D-01

target.execution: Playwright Chromium against published Pages with isolated temporary Git branch

principles: Acceptance criteria are fixed before execution and are not relaxed after observing results.
The browser must exercise the same published TSUGU UI used by humans.
Test projects are isolated on a temporary Git branch and deleted with the branch after evidence capture.
Approval/completion state must not be inferred or modified by the test.
A functionally successful flow can still FAIL usability when it requires redundant navigation or vertical travel.

scenarios.name: Initial connection and empty workspace comprehension
Register this frozen C-04 plan through the real import/save UI
actions: select generated schemaVersion 1 C-04 plan project
read back saved JSON from GitHub
pass: plan identity C-04/version 1 is preserved in the saved project

scenarios.name: Register representative 196-item workload through the real UI
pass: 35 構成 / 127 作業 / 34 検証

scenarios.name: Mobile layout and primary control visibility
pass: primary touch targets are at least 44x44 CSS px
fixed overlays do not cover the center point of active controls

scenarios.name: Desktop layout and primary control visibility
pass: fixed overlays do not cover the center point of active controls

scenarios.name: Vertical traversal efficiency
actions: from top controls open 項目
inspect from first visible item toward the last item
pass: down-up-down or up-down-up oscillation for one objective = 0
no return by >= one viewport followed by re-traversal toward the same target
scroll targets are not hidden under fixed overlays

scenarios.name: Tab and in-page interaction efficiency
pass: 概要/項目/AI引き継ぎ/高度なJSON switch without document navigation

scenarios.name: Save/reload state comprehension
pass: no duplicate record is created by reload

scenarios.name: Destructive action clarity and cleanup
pass: only selected test project is removed
list count decreases exactly by one per delete
deleted project does not reappear after reload

evidence.resultRule: All scenarios must PASS. Any budget breach is FAIL even if the functional operation succeeds.
